  PROBLEM: The new `::warning::Telegram returned no message id: <description>` stderr diagnostic at scripts/tg_helpers.sh:156-159 is thrown away by both P6b needs-human alert callers. These are scripts/unblock_judge.sh:234 `msg_id="$(tg_send_msg "${text}" CRITICAL 2>/dev/null || true)"` and scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22322 `msg_id="$(tg_send_msg "${alert_msg}" CRITICAL 2>/dev/null || true)"`. Both send tg_send_msg stderr to /dev/null, and the existing `::warning::Telegram send failed` at tg_helpers.sh:151 is lost the same way.
  WHY: When Telegram rejects the parking's single CRITICAL send (e.g. `Bad Request: chat not found`), the log shows only `NEEDS_HUMAN_ALERT ... outcome=unconfirmed reason=send_failed_or_ambiguous`, so the operator cannot tell a rejection from a curl timeout and the one attempt is used up with no visible cause. The stdout message-id contract and the never-retry behaviour are unaffected. All five reviewers rated this NIT, mapped here to low; there was no severity disagreement.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
